fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s resilience and tourism economy amid the absence of horse racing; criticism of high-pressure advertising and bankruptcy/receivership practices; public safety and civic concerns such as street lighting and transit service; court and legal notes including a supreme court decision affecting criminal libel; grand jury findings on Dade County commissioners’ handling of public funds; and columns touching on Hialeah, Miami Beach, and Coral Gables. Features a letter to the editor from a self-described “lady of the evening” describing exploitation and police raids, plus extensive local advertising and promotional material including development claims tied to the Tamiami Trail and a planned 1928 tourist-season celebration.
